stage00.briefing: Two defecting enemy scientists are waiting. Fly in and get them out.

stage01.briefing: Bring back as many of our captured lads as possible. They run to you once you stop or land on the correct spot.

stage02.briefing: Waste the enemy fuel storage facility.

stage03.briefing: Take out all the remaining POW holding huts.

stage10.briefing: Take out the chemical weapons facility.

stage11.briefing: Land outside the marked buildings. Our soldiers run in, steal vital information and run back to be picked up. Do not let any of them die.

stage12.briefing: Take out the nuclear missile silos. Rescue our captured troops if you have the chance.

stage13.briefing: Drop a saboteur off at each of the 3 tents. Once all are in, the tents explode and the agents run back to await pickup. Pick them all up and do not let any of them get killed.

stage20.briefing: Take out the helicopter takeoff pads.

stage21.briefing: Take out the enemy radar systems.

stage22.briefing: Two allied choppers are down but the crews are OK. Land in a clear spot near them and they will run to you.

stage23.briefing: Destroy the prototype four way firing installations.

stage30.briefing: Disable the soldier camp: destroy all enemy trucks and their main barracks.

stage31.briefing: Collect our captured soldiers from the marked buildings.

stage32.briefing: Two of our choppers went down holding vital intelligence. Land and let one of our troops collect it, then bring them back safely.

stage33.briefing: Take out the grounded enemy choppers.

stage40.briefing: Wipe out the enemy jet fighters.

stage41.briefing: Take out the supply trucks heading for the enemy base.

stage43.briefing: Disperse the enemy troops, then find the commanders building and destroy it.
